summary: Well-structured three-layer test suite (unit → workflow structure → e2e via act) that exercises all core retention policies (MaxAgeDays, KeepLatestN, MaxTotalSizeBytes), combined policies, dry-run mode, error handling, and output formatting. Layer 3 validates the complete workflow end-to-end through Docker via act with four fixture-based matrix test cases. Missing coverage: custom GroupBy values, CLI parameter override logic, OutputPath file writing, and edge cases (date boundary conditions, deterministic ordering on ties, very large sizes, policy values exactly at thresholds). Unit tests dot-source the script directly rather than running through the pipeline, though Layer 3's act integration compensates by validating the real execution path. Would catch most regressions but leaves boundary conditions and some feature paths unchecked.
